purpose: Compare the same variable-token MambaACF AutoCon forecaster with and without an independent raw static ACF direct-anchor residual.
research_question: Under the same variable-token MambaACF AutoCon architecture, train-only raw ACF sidecar, signed global relation objective, data split, optimizer, and short budget, does a per-channel maximum-|ACF| legal-lag signed direct anchor improve H96 forecasting over the nested no-anchor model?
evidence_boundary: This is an unauthorized exploratory mechanism screen on ETTh1 and Traffic at H96 with three paired seeds and eight epochs. It is not confirmatory evidence and cannot establish a general Mamba, ACF, variable-token, accuracy, speed, or publication claim.
claim_boundary: Only paired descriptive deltas, anchor availability/scale diagnostics, sidecar/config invariants, and separately measured resource costs may be reported. A favorable screen result requires a new reviewed replication and must not be pooled with other plans.

required_before_launch: human review of the direct-anchor estimand and its nested-baseline interpretation
confirm the train-only ACF sidecar identity, lag contract, and dataset fingerprints
review the scalar ReZero/indexed-gather resource budget and run a separate resource smoke benchmark
freeze the plan hash, create an approved launch sidecar, and use a fresh output root

prelaunch_gates: human review of the direct-anchor estimand and its nested-baseline interpretation
confirm the train-only ACF sidecar identity, lag contract, and dataset fingerprints
review the scalar ReZero/indexed-gather resource budget and run a separate resource smoke benchmark
freeze the plan hash, create an approved launch sidecar, and use a fresh output root

seed_policy.sidecar_policy: Fit the raw ACF sidecar from the training split only and require exact sidecar hash equality within every paired coordinate.
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use a fresh output root; do not copy metrics or checkpoints from another screen into this matrix.

phases.name: anchor_copy_off_h96
phases.purpose: Reference arm: the shared variable-token MambaACF AutoCon model with static train-only soft ACF memory and relation loss, but no direct-anchor residual.

phases.name: anchor_copy_on_h96
phases.purpose: Treatment arm: the exact reference configuration plus an independent scalar-ReZero signed direct anchor selected per channel from the maximum-|ACF| legal static lag.

MambaACFVariableAutoCon.provenance_rule: Persist the alias, executable model, and resolved overrides in every manifest record and config hash.

comparison_contract.one_factor_rule: The two phases must match on model alias and executable, variable-token trunk, gate mode, channel order, sidecar, ACF lags and selector, relation objective and lambda, optimizer, scheduler, split, batch, and epoch budget. Only mamba_acf_anchor_copy may differ.
planned_contrasts: anchor_copy_on_h96 minus anchor_copy_off_h96 for scaled MSE and scaled MAE
dataset-specific paired deltas for every seed
anchor scale, availability, selected-lag strength, and lag diagnostics
separately measured latency and peak-memory ratios
sidecar_invariants: exact acf_prior.npz hash equality within every dataset/seed pair
equal effective lags and relation candidate lags within every pair
train-only sidecar source; no validation or test target is read
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: Exploratory direct-anchor evidence only. Six paired coordinates can motivate a separately reviewed replication but cannot establish a general accuracy or efficiency advantage.

resource_contract.scope: Architecture-level direct-anchor cost estimate for pred_len=96; it excludes Mamba backend overhead, optimizer state, data loading, and the rest of the forecast trunk.
resource_contract.anchor_parameter_formula: 1 scalar ReZero parameter when enabled; zero when disabled
resource_contract.selection: per-channel maximum absolute train-only ACF among legal configured lags
resource_contract.causal_index: i = seq_len - 1 + h - lag; invalid entries are masked and contribute zero
resource_contract.measurement_policy: Before any launch, benchmark both modes with the same device, batch size, synthetic device-resident input, warmup, timed forwards, and deterministic source snapshot. Report median and p95 latency plus steady-state peak allocated/reserved memory; do not infer training speed from the MAC ratio alone.

engineering_budget.action_if_exceeded: stop the exploratory screen and do not promote direct-anchor retrieval without a new reviewed resource/accuracy design

stopping_rules: Do not launch without human review, a bound plan hash, approved launch sidecar, direct-anchor leakage review, immutable source/environment provenance, and a fresh output root.

Invalidate the affected phase for any missing or duplicate dataset/horizon/seed coordinate, non-ok manifest record, non-finite metric, changed artifact hash, source/provenance drift, or sidecar/effective-lag mismatch.
Analyze six paired coordinates and each dataset separately; never use test metrics to select an arm, add seeds, change horizons, or tune the gate after launch.

Stop and do not promote direct-anchor retrieval if it is favorable on fewer than 4/6 paired scaled-MSE coordinates, or on fewer than 2/3 seeds in either dataset, or if either dataset has mean relative scaled-MSE degradation greater than 1%.
Stop on the resource gate if the anchor median latency or peak allocated memory exceeds 1.25 times the no-anchor arm under the predeclared benchmark protocol.

If the accuracy and resource criteria are mixed, report the screen as exploratory and require a separately frozen replication; do not add lag-selection, scale, source, or gate interaction arms after seeing results.
Reject a treatment checkpoint if anchor_scale remains exactly zero in all epochs, no valid anchor fraction is observed, or the persisted lag/index diagnostics are incomplete.
